title: Fix 3D Prefab Variant Array Composition
body:
Resolves an issue where 3D prefab variant elements failed to compose due to arrays parsing logic. Modified `UnityPrefabModificationApplier` to support array index mapping and exclude Unity's `.Array` dummy path properties. Included testing inside `UnityPrefabParser.test.ts` to prevent regressions.
